messages:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout of infra/bridge-service v2.4.1 to 10% of prod traffic (eu1). Canaries passed basic health checks.

sara: quick heads-up — synth-probes for the bridge route are spiking in eu1, p95 latency up ~120ms vs baseline and seeing a few 502s from sidecar pool. Not a full outage but worth pausing.

mike: saw that in telemetry too. Is this from new batching knobs or the kernel change from yesterday?

alin: looks correlated with the prefill/kv-warmup changes in v2.4.1 — queues are higher during cold starts. Reproducer on staging: 1: create burst 2: tail logs -> sidecar OOM-ish.

noah: can we get the deploy bot to pause the ramp for eu1? I'm +1 on holding.

clara: /rollout pause infra/bridge-service eu1 -> done (by deploy-bot). Holding ramp at 10%.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for infra/bridge-service v2.4.1 in eu1 by clara. Current traffic: 10%. Reason: post-deploy synthetic probe variance.

sara: sample log snippet from eu1 sidecar between 09:14:22-09:14:35:
```
[09:14:22] sidecar-12e: failed to forward request: downstream closed (502)
[09:14:23] sidecar-07a: kv-cache miss spike, prefills queued=78
[09:14:30] host-3c: OOM_killed_process=bridge-worker - memory 84%->95%
```

mike: ok looks like memory pressure on a subset of instances during warmup bursts. Could be a bad prefill batch size.

alin: I can push a small hotfix to revert the prefill batch change (revert commit d4f2b9) and ship v2.4.2 to eu1-only canary. Preferable to rollback?

noah: prefer patch to full rollback if it tests quickly. We have capacity to run eu1 canary at 5% with circuit fallback.

clara: action items: alin -> build v2.4.2 reverting prefill batch, mike -> coordinate canary push, sara -> run focused synth probe runs against canary, noah -> monitor k8s pod OOMs and autoscaler.

alin: starting build now. ETA ~12m. Will tag eu1-canary.

deploy-bot: Noted: scheduled post-build smoke script to run after artifact push.

sara: I'll run the synthetic suite against eu1-canary once it's live. Also adding a short-run ramp test (burst 200 reqs/s for 30s) to simulate warmup.

mike: if canary looks good (p95 within 20ms of baseline and zero 502s in 10m window) -> resume ramp to 50% and continue. If not, fallback to v2.4.0 pin for eu1 and open incident.

deploy-bot: canary push initiated for infra/bridge-service v2.4.2 (eu1-canary).

[~12 minutes later]

deploy-bot: infra/bridge-service v2.4.2 (eu1-canary) deployed to 5% traffic. Health checks OK.

sara: ran synth burst. Results: p95 back to baseline +/-8ms, retries/502=0 across 10m. Pod memory stable.

mike: great. mike: /rollout resume infra/bridge-service eu1 -> done (by deploy-bot). Ramp to 50% in 10m.

noah: monitoring shows steady CPU/mem and no OOMs. Autoscaler keeping up.

clara: I'll update release notes and record the short postdeploy observation in the release channel. Also flag for small follow-up to adjust prefill batch default for low-memory hosts.

alin: will open PR with the revert and add a targeted unit test for prefills.

mike: thanks team. Closing hold. If anything else pops up, @oncall please escalate.

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed for infra/bridge-service v2.4.2 in eu1. Current plan: ramp to 50% then to 100% over 30m with synthetic checks at each step.

clara: follow-up ticket: BRIDGE-4123 — investigate prefills vs host memory tiers. Assigned to alin.

sara: adding note to runbook: run quick synth burst after initial canary in eu regions where host memory < 128GB.

mike: nice one. Thanks everyone :rocket:
